keep.text: Sunne mein fake lagega, par
ye baat 100% sach hai ki maine 25 kilo
ghataye hain, sirf aur sirf 45 din mein.
Maine meri wife ka BP normal kiya hua hai
sirf aur sirf lifestyle change karne se.
Maine apni mummy ka psoriasis theek kiya hai, sirf aur sirf lifestyle changes
karne se.
Maine
5000 logon se bhi zyada logon ko water fast karaya hai
aur unki life mein ek achha change aaya hai.
Aap soch rahe ho ki haan, ye toh sab bolte hain. Aisa hi soch rahe ho?
Lekin main aap logon ko proof de raha hoon.

Ek nahi, teen nahi, poore 5000 logon ko maine water fasting karayi hai. Aur us water fasting se in logon ka insulin resistance bhi theek hua hai, in logon ka weight loss bhi bahut achhe tareeke se hua hai.
Bahut saare BP patients ka BP
normal rehne laga hai.
Bahut saare logon ka psoriasis ka flare kam hone laga hai.
Aur ye saari cheezein sirf aur sirf lifestyle changes karne se aayi hain.
Toh agar aap logon ke lifestyle mein kharabi hai,
toh aap logon ko ek achhe se protocol ki zaroorat hai jo
aap logon ko
regulate kare,
jo aap logon

ke liye ek proper system bana sake, ki kaise khana hai, kya khana hai, kaise exercise karni hai, kaun si exercise karni hai. Ye saari cheezein agar aapko day by day mil jaayein, toh aap log ye saari cheezein set karke apni lifestyle apne tareeke se bana sakte ho.
Aur ye koi coincidence nahi hai, ye poora ka poora ek system hai.
Aur ye poora ka poora system
main aap logon ko bataunga ek webinar mein.
Link neeche hai,
webinar abhi join kariye, milte hain aap logon se webinar mein!
